about: Labels for the openly licensed stock takes (Pexels licence, accepted by the team on #18). No take is listed until simon-part-2 delivers the stock pose3d.json files and scripts/import-stock-takes.sh has imported them: make report-real then says the fallback set is used. Each take later gets a folder <take_id>/ beside this file with skeleton.json and SOURCE.md, and one entry in takes with label_source visual, the labeller and the expected clip. See SOURCE.md.
